messages:
sam: Quick PSA — noticed a weird inheritance edgecase in the console SLO editor. tenant-level SLO set to `inherit` + route override that disables notify fanout => alerts still fan out. :thinking:

maria: Ugh. Can you paste the route config? sounds like a merge-order bug.

sam: Config snippet:
```json
{
  \"tenant_slo\": { \"threshold\": 0.99, \"notify\": { \"fanout\": true } },
  \"route\": { \"slo_inherit\": true, \"notify\": { \"fanout\": false } }
}
```

kevin: Hmm, if route.slo_inherit == true we normally apply tenant_slo and then layer route.notify on top (route should win). Might be a short-circuit where we early-return on inherit.

irene: @kevin yeah we added an optimization that returns tenant object when inherit==true to avoid deep-merge — probably skipping notify merge.

maria: That matches. UX-wise, reporter will see route-level toggle off but backend still fans out. Bad.

kevin: Quick fix idea: change early-return to shallow-merge for notify/contact fields only. Cheap and low-risk.

sam: Agreed. Also telemetry: when this mismatch happens we should tag alerts with "notify_inconsistency: true" so we can query how often.

devops-bot: Deploy request created by kevin:deploy-fix/notify-merge — CI passed. (#4123) :rocket:

irene: Can we add a console warning in the editor if route inherits but has any notify toggles set? e.g., tooltip: "Values appear overridden but merge optimization may skip nested fields". Simple callout.

maria: I like that. Helps customers and reduces pager noise.

kevin: I'll submit PR with three things: (1) shallow-merge for notify/contact, (2) add signal tag `notify_inconsistency` when detected, (3) small editor tooltip. Aim to get canary out tomorrow.

sam: Perfect. Add a small e2e test too — verify route toggle false => no fanout.

maria: Thx. tagging @irene for rollout plan/telemetry dashboard update once canary is healthy. :+1:

irene: Will add a mini-panel to the SLO telemetry dashboard to surface that tag and a rollup over last 7 days.

sam: Great. Closing the loop here — thanks team.

kevin: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/4123 — leaving a note in the changelog about behavior fix and console hint.

maria: Nice. After canary, let's run a sweep for other early-return patterns in policy merges. Might be more edgecases. :eyes:

sam: Yup. follow-up ticket created.

devops-bot: Canary deployment scheduled for 2026-04-02T02:00:00Z. Monitoring alert channel: #release-war-room.
